description: This file defines the DbLog class which implements a logger interface for logging events into the Drupal watchdog database table. It manages database connections, formats log messages, and handles database exceptions during logging.

classes.name: DbLog
classes.description: A logger class that logs events into the Drupal watchdog database table, handling database connection management and exception handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database connection and message parser.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified level and context, handling database insertion and reconnection on errors.
